# Public Help Center

> > Official help documentation for Public, covering investing, tax reporting, account management, and platform features including Public Premium, Alpha, Treasury Accounts, Bond Accounts, and cryptocurrency.

Public is an investing platform offering stocks, bonds, Treasury bills, crypto, and alternative assets. This help center provides comprehensive guidance on account setup, trading, tax documents (1099s), retirement accounts (IRAs), and premium features.

## Key Topics

- Public Premium
- Alpha
- Individual Retirement Accounts (IRA)
- Treasury Accounts (T-bills)
- Bond Accounts
- Yield Accounts
- Tax documents (1099)
- Crypto tax reporting
- Securities lending
- Account management
- Brokerage account setup
- Bank account linking
- Price alerts
- Safety labels

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://help.public.com/en/collections/766028-getting-started): Account setup guide covering eligibility, verification, and basics

## How Public Works

- [How Public Works](https://help.public.com/en/collections/2520246-how-public-works): Platform overview covering Public Premium, Alpha, and core features

## Tax & Reporting

- [Public Tax Center](https://help.public.com/tax-center/en/): Tax center for IRA, Bond Accounts, T-bills, and crypto tax documents
- [Tax Questions](https://help.public.com/en/collections/2699406-tax-questions): Tax FAQ covering 1099 forms, crypto taxes, and fractional shares reporting

## Account Management

- [Where do I find my account number?](https://help.public.com/en/articles/4375182-where-do-i-find-my-account-number): Find your Public brokerage account number via mobile app or website
- [How can I manually connect my bank account?](https://help.public.com/en/articles/5222156-how-can-i-manually-connect-my-bank-account): Manual bank linking guide using Apex Clearing micro deposits
